dedupe_keys.name: support codes and dataset for industrial energy efficiency and decarbonisation via electrification and hydrogen

description: This release archives datasets and algorithms accompanying a 2026 industrial energy-efficiency and decarbonisation article. Zenodo lists one public version 2.0 code archive under MIT and links the authors’ GitHub repository, whose README confirms the article and supplementary purpose. It can be a starting point for reproducing electrification or hydrogen process-energy cases in industrial transition simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this supplementary package. A limitation is that the public landing description and repository README do not enumerate plant technologies, geographic cases, input schemas or software dependencies. Those details remain inside the archive and must be inspected before a modeller treats any scenario as transferrable. The deposit is article-specific and does not by itself establish a general industrial planner. Repository metadata report Jupyter Notebook as the main language, but file-level execution requirements were not checked. The archive was not downloaded or executed and no energy-saving value was reproduced.
